# Use cases

<!-- Generated from the front matter in usecases/*.md by `./run.py gallery usecases-md`. Do not edit by hand. -->

What you can do with RemotiveTopology, shown with the examples in this repository. The
[example gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples) on the developer site has all of them, with pictures and filters.

| Use case | Goal | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| [Behavioral model and test](usecases/BEHAVIORAL_MODEL_TEST.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/behavioral-model-test)) | Start here | A BCM model and a test of the hazard lights, explained step by step |
| [Restbus](usecases/RESTBUS.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/restbus)) | Simulate | Send every frame of an ECU from its database, and set signal values from Python |
| [Same tests as the ECU matures](usecases/ETHERNET_GATEWAY.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/ethernet-gateway)) | Test | One test for a gateway ECU, whether it is a model, a container or hardware |
| [Raw playback with video](usecases/PLAYBACK_RAW.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/raw-playback)) | Replay | Replay a recorded Tesla Model 3 drive, with its camera videos, onto its CAN buses |
| [Replay candump or CSV](usecases/REPLAY_CAN.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/replay-can)) | Replay | Play a candump or CSV recording onto a CAN bus |
| [Inspect traffic with Edgeshark](usecases/EDGESHARK.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/edgeshark)) | Visualize | Capture the network traffic of the topology's containers in Wireshark |
| [Physical CAN device](usecases/HARDWARE_CAN.md) ([gallery](https://developer.remotivelabs.com/docs/get-started/examples/hardware-can)) | Integrate | Attach a simulated ECU to a real CAN interface on the host |

More use cases are in [RemotiveCar](https://github.com/remotivelabs/remotivelabs-remotive-car/blob/main/USECASES.md).
